name: The Fruit Loop
schedule: The first Friday of every month, starting Fri, Dec 4, 2026. Meet 6:30 pm at the rainbow crosswalk at Central Ave and Portland St; it rolls at 7:00 pm and is back about 8:45 pm.

start_location.name: The rainbow crosswalk at Central Ave and Portland St
start_location.address: N Central Ave and W Portland St, Phoenix, AZ 85004

pace: About 10 mph, flat. Nobody gets dropped.
founded_note: The first ride is Fri, Dec 4, 2026.
visitor_notes: Lights are required: white on the front, red on the back. It's dark by the start from fall to spring. 18 and up. No sign-up. Nobody is in a photo unless they take a "Photos OK" sticker at the start.
description: A queer social night ride through central Phoenix history, hosted by Robert Castan of Cycle for Change. About 13 flat miles from the 2018 rainbow crosswalk at Central and Portland, through Coronado, Steele Indian School Park, the Melrose Curve and Encanto Park, and back along the old Fruit Loop bar circuit on Roosevelt. No-drop, about 10 mph, free.
evidence: Robert Castan hosts it. On Oct 23, 2026 he set the first ride for Fri, Dec 4, 2026, then the first Friday of every month: meet 6:30 pm, roll 7:00 pm at the Central and Portland rainbow crosswalk, about 13 miles, no-drop.

refresh.notes: Robert's own ride. Re-check by asking him; /fruitloop/ is its page.
